page: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the e2 family. It is equipped with 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon core with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 2.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes a 55 MB L3 cache. It does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the e2-standard-2 sits in the lower performance tiers. Its stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 1103.39 is categorized in the bottom 25%, while its multi-core score of 1451.58 falls in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show 79.92 GB/sec for cached small blocks and drop to 11.77 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Geekbench testing reports a single-core score of 867.0 and a multi-core score of 1025.0, reflecting limited compute capacity under heavy workloads.

Given its hardware profile, the e2-standard-2 is structured for entry-level, non-resource-intensive workloads. It is suitable for basic web serving, light background processing, and small-scale development or testing environments. The lack of local NVMe storage and low database operation benchmarks make it less suitable for high-throughput database systems or intensive data processing. It offers a cost-efficient entry point for general-purpose tasks that do not require high CPU or memory bandwidth.
description: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-2 is a general-purpose instance featuring 2 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor running at 2.2 GHz. This configuration utilizes 1 physical core with 2 threads and includes a 55 MB L3 cache, but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Performance benchmarks place the instance in the lower tiers, with a single-core Geekbench score of 867.0 and a multi-core score of 1025.0. Its memory read bandwidth is measured at 11.77 GB/sec for large blocks, and static web serving throughput reaches 1.45 GB/sec. Given these performance characteristics, the e2-standard-2 is best suited for low-intensity workloads, such as basic web serving, development environments, and lightweight administrative tasks where resource demands are minimal and cost-efficiency is prioritized.
